preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a multiple > 1 to mint new tokens to the rewardsPool address. First ensure rewardsPool is set (via setRewardsPool()) to an address you control, then call rebase(2) to double the token supply and mint tokens to your controlled rewardsPool address. Alternatively, if you can become owner through transferOwnership(), do that first.
